frequency_question: How often does an agenda item concerning financial sector taxation or exemptions proceed from initial committee deliberation to a formal Council announcement within 60 days?
membership_rule: Includes any formal agenda item on banking, NBFC, or financial intermediary tax rates discussed in GST Council meetings between 2021 and 2026 where preliminary signals were visible; excludes state-level local cesses.

known_gaps: Does not fully capture informal deferrals driven by upcoming electoral cycles.
skeleton: 10 named agenda items with visible preliminary signals where the Council either decided within a short window or deferred.
multiplier: 7 hits out of 10 observed similar precedent states
validity_reason: GST Council institutional procedures and voting dynamics remain stable under the current administration.
